archetypes.name: dyn-escalation-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Ledger row filtering now decides whether approved designs file escalation-success reports.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design failure-report evidence scanner and tests. Focus on whether normal step3-review handoff rows are suppressed while genuine Step 3 failures, mixed rows, fallback rows, record-failure markers, and non-step3 escalation rows still count. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
